in_hebrew.name: גּרגֶּרדּ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גּרדּ (גּר) + גּגּ (גּ) = דּוּדּ (דּ) - גּרדּ - גּ = root of joy, happiness, and peace. גּגּ - root of earth, ground. דּוּדּ - earth, land, or home. גּרדּ - root of joy, gladness, or happiness. גּ - root of good or earth. דּ - root of ground or earth. Hebrew name Gertrude, means joy of the earth or happiness of the land. In biblical context, the name symbolizes a joyful and peaceful person who finds happiness in the earth and its goodness. The name Gertrude is also associated with the virtue of gratitude and appreciation for the beauty of nature.
